title: Personal Development Projects
fullDescription: This section features a collection of my personal development projects, showcasing my exploration into diverse areas of technology and creative coding. It includes 'Face,' an application focused on high-quality face creation using machine learning; my personal website, a unique blend of a traditional site with Unity WebGL integration and various performance and security enhancements; and a 360 Video Application designed to allow a user to manage and showcase their collection of immersive 360 videos on an interactive map.

process.title: Face: High-Quality Face Creation with Machine Learning
process.description: In 2018, I conceptualized and prototyped 'Face,' an application aimed at teaching machines to sculpt, specifically focusing on generating high-quality 3D face models using machine learning. The idea was to create an environment for the creation, generation, prediction, and stylization of user-created heads with minimal input. This involved exploring data storage for head forms, anatomical features, and uniqueness to train several AI models. The application was designed for dataset creation, training models, and importing/exporting face data, with the goal of artists being able to generate rigged and textured 3D faces automatically.

process.title: My Website: Unity Portfolio with Advanced Features
process.description: My personal website is a unique blend of traditional web design and Unity WebGL integration, developed entirely with AI assistance. It features graceful loading with particle animation, automatic orientation handling, platform detection, robust error handling, performance monitoring, and memory management for Unity instances. The site also includes dynamic portfolio management, lazy loading of images, a responsive design, and detailed work pages. Performance was a key focus, incorporating efficient resource loading, service worker for offline support, DNS prefetching, and caching strategies. Security was also paramount, with features like CSP, strict referrer policy, and HTTPS enforcement. Additionally, it's a Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline functionality and installability, while also prioritizing accessibility with ARIA landmarks and keyboard navigation.

process.title: 360 Video Application: Interactive World Exploration
process.description: I developed a personal application to help a friend manage and showcase their extensive collection of 360 videos captured from travels around the world. The application features an interactive map interface, allowing users to click on locations to access and view the corresponding immersive 360 video. The application provides administrative capabilities for adding, removing, and managing the 360 video content, with potential for future integration into games and other applications.
